english.title: Person supply on behalf of a licensed club alcohol to a club member under 18
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) supplied on behalf of a club, namely **(..SPECIFY THE CLUB AND LOCATION..), alcohol to or to the order of a club member under the age of 18, namely **(..SPECIFY THE AGE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 146(3)(a) and (7) of the Licensing Act 2003.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
supplied on behalf of a licensed club
alcohol to / to the order of a club member
under the age of eighteen years

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
As from 08/04/2013 Penalty Notices for Disorder may ONLY be issued to offenders aged 18 years or over.

This offence may be disposed of by the issue of a Penalty Notice for Disorder - DA17

(i) The Penalty Notice for Disorder was raised from £80 to £90 as from 01/07/13
(ii) Please be aware of similar wordings in H5473, H5474, H5476 and ensure you have selected the right one.
(iii) This offence is recordable at PNC - although it is not an imprisonable offence per S.I. 2005/3106

welsh.welshlegislation: Yn groes i adran 146(3)(a) a (7) Deddf Trwyddedu 2003

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Penalty Notice for Disorder - Ninety pounds.

Note:
As from 08/04/2013 Penalty Notices for Disorder may ONLY be issued to offenders aged 18 years or over.

Time limit for prosecutions:
12 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
